$comment: Written by tools/build-deck.ts into decks/hulk-family.dck. decks/README.md says what it is and how the AI plays it; docs/evidence/more-villains.md what was run.
name: Hulk Family (Marvel Super Heroes gamma)
archetype: stompy: gamma tramplers that grow each other with +1/+1 counters, on two Birds of Paradise

cards.name: Rick Jones, Destined Sidekick
cards.why: the teenager Banner saved from the gamma bomb test: digs four deep for a Hero

cards.name: Birds of Paradise
cards.why: the one generic reprint: mana of any colour, so the Hulks land a turn early

cards.name: Brawn, Amadeus Cho
cards.why: the Totally Awesome Hulk: draws a card; castable with {G}

cards.name: Hellcat, Undying Vigilante
cards.why: a Defender beside Hulk: 2/2 haste who comes back once

cards.name: Knight of Wundagore
cards.why: the High Evolutionary's cat-men, a Villain 2-drop: every +1/+1 counter the Hulks hand out grows them too, and a Villain's combat damage grows Abomination

cards.name: Gallant Citizen
cards.why: a generic citizen from MSC (its flavour text is J. Jonah Jameson's): a 1/1 that draws a card; castable with {G}{G}

cards.name: HULK SMASH!
cards.why: a creature of yours deals its power to one of theirs

cards.name: Gamma Grotesque
cards.why: 3/3 vigilance whose power-up draws

cards.name: She-Hulk, Attorney-at-Law
cards.why: 3/3 vigilance for three; castable with {G}

cards.name: Hercules, Prince of Power
cards.why: Amadeus Cho's partner after World War Hulk: 3/3, power-up makes him indestructible

cards.name: Hulkling, Burgeoning Bruiser
cards.why: the Young Avenger named for Hulk: 2/3 vigilance that grows when a bigger creature arrives

cards.name: Hulk, Brutal Brawler
cards.why: attacks every combat and grows the rest of the team

cards.name: Hulk, Strongest There Is
cards.why: doubles the +1/+1 counters on every Gamma each upkeep

cards.name: Abomination, Irradiated Brute
cards.why: 4/4 trample that grows from a Gamma's combat damage

cards.name: Abomination, Terrifying Titan
cards.why: 4/4 trample; power-up fights

cards.name: She-Hulk, Jade Defender
cards.why: 4/4 reach trample

cards.name: Wolverine, Fierce Fighter
cards.why: his first appearance was a fight with Hulk (Incredible Hulk #181): 3/5 haste that fights on arrival

cards.name: Hulk, Gamma Goliath
cards.why: 6/5 reach trample; power-ups cost {3} less

cards.name: Red Hulk
cards.why: 6/7 reach trample that shoots back when hurt

cards.name: Los Diablos Missile Base
cards.why: where Banner tested the gamma bomb (its flavour text is Ross's): R/G, enters tapped, gain 1

cards.name: Training Compound
cards.why: R/G while you control a basic

cards.name: Rootbound Crag
cards.why: R/G, untapped with a Mountain or Forest out

cards.name: Forest
cards.why: green is the main colour: every double pip is green

cards.name: Mountain
cards.why: red the second, single-pip except Red Hulk
